name: headcountlabs-companies
description: Look up U.S. companies from public records: SEC EDGAR, GLEIF, USAspending, Wikidata and state business registries. Find a company by name or web domain, get one by ticker, CIK, LEI, Wikidata ID or domain, and list its direct parents and subsidiaries from GLEIF and Wikidata ownership links. Every record names its sources, and get_company_record returns the full source-linked record. Read-only, no account or API key. Preview data: coverage is partial and unknown fields are null.
